title: Lenses
summary: Convex lenses bring light together and concave lenses spread it out. Magnifying glasses, cameras, spectacles and your own eye.

ib.note: Lens formula and power are CBSE Class 10 / MYP 5

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 10: Light: Mirrors and Lenses

objectives: I can distinguish convex (converging) and concave (diverging) lenses.
I can describe the images formed by a convex lens for different object positions.
I can explain uses of lenses, including spectacles.
misconceptions: A magnifying glass makes the object itself bigger.
